mentions.name: Doors
mentions.description: A window manager for Windows, inspired by Hyprland, currently at MVP stage. Development includes reworking the region build system and potentially redesigning the architecture to use a tree-based approach for managing windows.
mentions.problem: Existing window managers for Windows are slow or buggy, and none looked nice; the author wanted a good-looking window manager for when they work on Windows while dual booting.
